title: SB2887 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-01; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514140725 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/SB2887.pdf (LegiScan doc 2911848))
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-02-01); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing. House twin is HB 2963 (same document).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1302(a)): (8) A switch or auto sear device designed, made, or intended for use in converting a weapon to shoot automatically more than one (1) shot, without manual reloading, by a single function of the trigger.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1302(d)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1302(d), is amended by deleting "(a)(3) or (a)(4)" and substituting "(a)(3), (a)(4), or (a)(8)".
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1302(f)): (5) An offense under subdivision (a)(8) is a Class E felony.
